payload.waste_leads: Major rework: i8b was walked through nearly all of M1 (vision, as-is, RAID, frame, scope, PR/FAQ) with its motivation gate blessed, then ABANDONED when the owner surfaced the worktree/branching execution model. Root cause: the iteration's EXECUTION MODEL (own branch/worktree + local seed-trim machine) was not settled before walking, so M1 was authored on the wrong footing. DURABLE LEAD: when an iteration's execution model is unsettled (branch? local machine? refine cut?), settle it BEFORE walking, not mid-M1.
payload.process_stale: YES - the headline. v2's process, as ported, is STALE against v1's own bar (owner-flagged, note-cc4c498ca67f). v1 had red-teams asking 'did we build the RIGHT thing?' and a validation phase that caught mis-builds; v2 has M8 Validate + gates, yet they passed a feature shipped effectively OFF (opt-in nobody sets) and never run live. Two holes: (1) Validate does not trace each BLESSED goal / plan step to a passing LIVE end-to-end test - unit-green masqueraded as done; (2) delegated self-blessing had no red-team lens, so a scope-narrowing choice passed unchallenged (the delegation blind spot). Deep dive owed at the next retro per the owner; leads: Validate must map blessed-goal -> live-test; restore a standing red-team question 'is this the thing the owner blessed, run for real?'; audit what the v1->v2 port dropped (the missing method/prompts/engage.md is one more instance).
